newsitem.title: REPUBLIC OF IRELAND: Army blows up suspect cargo on grounded plan.
newsitem.headline: Army blows up suspect cargo on grounded plan.

text.p: Irish bomb disposal experts carried out two controlled explosions on Friday on cargo found in an Air France plane which was diverted to Ireland after a bomb scare, police said.
They said scanning equipment detected something suspect in crates in the cargo hold but it was not known if a bomb was to blame.
"The scanning equipment detected something. We don't take any chances," a police spokeswoman said.
Police said further checks were continuing on cargo found in the hold and results would not be known until later.
The Airbus was on a flight from Paris to Mexico city on Thursday when it was routed to Ireland's transatlantic terminus of Shannon because of a bomb warning.
All 220 passengers left Ireland earlier in the day on another aircraft, airport officials said.
